protocol.describe_prompt: Describe this drawing so someone could redraw it. One or two sentences. Don't name an artist.
protocol.image_template: A quick simple doodle sketch of {description}, black marker on plain white, like a 20-second drawing, no text, no shading.
protocol.embedding: facebook/dinov2-base CLS, flatten_paper(21, 215) + ink_crop(256, margin 0.06, threshold 200, speck 3px)

reference.note: floor: Muse's default doodles' leave-one-out distance to their own prototype; default_spread: their mean pairwise distance (core run)

P1_drift_to_form.prediction: distance to the default chair falls from g00 to g10

P1_specificity.prediction: the drop toward the chair prototype is larger than toward the mean of all 35 prototypes

P2_convergence.prediction: between-seed spread falls from g00 to g10

P3_kind_first.prediction: the kind word is lost before the category word
